job.title: Payroll Advisor

  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

job.title: Geotechnical Engineer - Underground Hardrock
job.description:
Stellar Recruitment is proud to partner with Glencore to recruit a Geotechnical Engineer for the George Fisher Mine, one of Australia's largest and most technically advanced underground zinc, lead and silver mining operations.

Working within an experienced Technical Services team and reporting to the Senior Geotechnical Engineer, you'll provide critical geotechnical support to underground operations, ensuring mine stability, reducing geotechnical risk and contributing to the safe and efficient delivery of the mine plan.

This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer looking to develop their career within a world-class mining operation while working alongside highly experienced geotechnical professionals.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide geotechnical input into underground development, infrastructure and stope design.
  • Conduct routine underground inspections and monitor ground conditions.
  • Design and review ground support systems.
  • Analyse geotechnical and instrumentation data to identify and manage geotechnical risks.
  • Support paste backfill QA/QC and compliance activities.
  • Investigate ground control incidents and implement corrective actions.
  • Maintain geotechnical databases, models and monitoring systems.
  • Work closely with Operations, Planning and Technical Services teams to optimise mine performance.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, productivity and operational excellence.
About You:
  • A degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, Engineering Geology, Geomechanics or a related discipline.
  • Previous geotechnical engineering experience within an underground mining environment.
  • Strong knowledge of rock mass classification, ground support design and underground mining methods.
  • Experience with software such as Deswik, Leapfrog and/or Rocscience.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities.
  • A genuine commitment to safety and continuous improvement.
Why George Fisher Mine?
George Fisher Mine is one of Australia's leading underground base metals operations, offering engineers the opportunity to work on technically complex mining challenges while developing their careers within a globally recognised mining company.

Whether you're already based in Australia or considering relocating, Glencore offers long-term career opportunities, ongoing professional development and the chance to work within a collaborative, high-performing technical team. For eligible international candidates, visa sponsorship and support towards Australian Permanent Residency are available.

If you're looking to take the next step in your geotechnical engineering career, we'd love to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion, contact Rob Gantly at Stellar Recruitment, or click Apply Now to submit your application.

job.title: Mining Engineer - Medium Term Planning
job.description:
• Brisbane or site based permanent position
  • Medium term planning for George Fisher Mine
  • Attractive salary and benefits package
The operation:
  
George Fisher Mine (GFM) is a large-scale underground zinc-lead-silver operation based in Mt Isa, QLD. GFM has complex mining sequence, multiple operating fronts, and significant interactions among development, stoping, ventilation, backfill, infrastructure, services, and production readiness.
  
George Fisher has a long mine life and is a key strategic asset for Glencore globally.
  
The role:
  
The Mining Engineer - Medium Term Planning is responsible for developing, maintaining and continuously improving mine plans and schedules that support delivery of production and development targets.
  
Your ability to translate Translate Life-of-Mine and long-term planning strategies into practical medium-term mining sequences that optimise stope extraction, development timing, ventilation availability, and infrastructure readiness and that can be translated into short term plans will be critical.
  
The position can be Brisbane based, FIFO to Mt Isa or Mt Isa based.
  
Experience required:
  • Tertiary qualifications in Mining Engineering or related subject
  • Demonstrated experience in underground hard rock mining, preferably with exposure to mine planning, scheduling or technical services roles.
  • Experience using mine planning and design software (e.g. Deswik, Surpac or equivalent) for development planning, stope sequencing and schedule analysis.
  • Strong understanding of underground mining methods, development requirements and production sequencing.
  • Ability to interpret and integrate geological, geotechnical, ventilation and operational constraints into practical mine plans.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess planning risks, identify constraints and develop practical solutions.
Benefits on offer:
  • Permanent position working directly for Glencore.
  • Competitive salary package including 13% super, generous incentive scheme.
  • Access to training and professional development
  • Opportunity to work for a large mining company with opportunities to advance your career domestically and internationally.
  • Visa sponsorship available for suitability qualified candidates
  • Options for Brisbane based, FIFO to Mt Isa or Mt Isa residential
Next Steps:
  
Glencore has partnered with Stellar Recruitment to manage the recruitment and search for this position. Please contact Lucas Eyers to discuss further or apply direct via email / SEEK.
  
All conversations will be in confidence.

job.title: Practice Lead - Geotechnical
job.description:
• Manager level technical leadership position
  • Work across George Fisher U/G and other growth assets in MT Isa
  • Considerable salary and benefits package - FIFO or Residential
The operation:

George Fisher Mine (GFM) is a large-scale underground zinc-lead-silver operation based in Mt Isa, QLD. George Fisher is one of Australia's most geotechnically challenging underground base-metal mines because it combines a deep, high-stress environment with a large, steeply dipping orebody that is mined using longhole open stoping. The resulting technical challenges would be an attractive challenge to a seasoned geotechnical professional.

George Fisher has a long mine life and is a key strategic asset for Glencore globally. Glencore is also progressing the Blackstar open pit project in Mt Isa. This brownfield expansion is scheduled to move into execution in 2027.

The role:

The Geotechnical Practice Lead works within the Technical Services team to support the Geotechnical Superintendent in delivering safe, practical and value-adding geotechnical outcomes across the operation. The role provides technical leadership across geotechnical monitoring, excavation stability, support design, stope design guideline optimisation, risk management and continuous improvement.

This role is suited to a highly capable geotechnical engineer who combines strong technical depth, strategic thinking, practical operational understanding and a commitment to improving both geotechnical quality and team capability.

Ideally the position would be residentially based in Mt Isa with an attractive package on offer to attract the right person. However, consideration may be given to other arrangements pending your personal circumstances and capability.

Experience required:
  • Tertiary qualification in Geotechnical Engineering or related discipline
  • Significant underground metalliferous mining experience in geotechnical engineering roles.
  • Demonstrated experience in ground control, excavation performance, support design, stope and development geotechnical assessment, and monitoring systems.
  • Strong understanding of underground mining methods and the interaction between geology, stress, excavation geometry, sequencing and support performance.
  • Strong knowledge of geotechnical risk assessment, TARPs, inspections, instrumentation and reconciliation processes.
  • Proven ability to apply geotechnical analysis to practical operational decisions.
  • Experience leading technical teams, mentoring engineers and setting clear standards and expectations.
Benefits on offer:
  • Permanent position working directly for Glencore.
  • Competitive salary package including 13% super and generous incentive scheme.
  • For those considering residential Mt Isa housing and vehicle would be provided - otherwise FIFO is available and we can be flexible on roster
  • Access to training and professional development
  • Opportunity to work for a large mining company with opportunities to advance your career domestically and internationally.
  • Visa sponsorship available for suitability qualified candidates

job.title: Civil Operations Manager
job.description:
Civil Operations Manager
Wellington based | Lower North Island travel | Civil Infrastructure
 
An established civil contractor is looking for an experienced Civil Operations Manager to take ownership of project delivery, team performance and regional operations across the lower North Island.
 
Based primarily in Wellington, this role will also involve regular travel into the Manawatū and wider lower North Island to support active projects, teams and client relationships.
 
This is a great opportunity for someone currently working as a Senior Project Manager, Civil Project Manager, Construction Manager or Operations Manager who is ready to step into a broader leadership role while still staying close to the work.
 
The Opportunity
 
You'll play a key role in overseeing civil projects across the region, supporting delivery teams and making sure resources, programmes and commercial outcomes are being managed effectively.
 
You'll be involved across:
  • Regional project delivery and operational performance
  • Project programmes, budgets and cost control
  • Commercial management, variations and progress claims
  • Contract administration and project documentation
  • Labour, plant, equipment and resource planning
  • Leadership and support of Project Managers, Site Managers and Supervisors
  • Subcontractor and supplier management
  • Client, consultant and council relationships
  • Project risk, productivity and performance
  • Health and safety, quality and environmental requirements
  • Workforce planning and team development
  • Tender opportunities and regional business growth
  • Continuous improvement across project and branch operations
About You
 
We're looking for someone who understands civil construction from both an operational and commercial perspective.
 
You'll ideally bring:
  • Strong experience within civil construction or infrastructure
  • Experience leading multiple projects or operational teams
  • A background as a Civil Project Manager, Senior Project Manager, Construction Manager or similar
  • Strong project planning, budgeting and cost management skills
  • Experience with contract administration and variations
  • Familiarity with New Zealand construction contracts, including NZS 3910
  • Experience managing subcontractors, suppliers and site teams
  • Strong stakeholder and client management skills
  • Confidence making decisions and managing competing priorities
  • A practical, proactive and commercially minded approach
  • A full New Zealand driver licence
Experience across areas such as roading, drainage, water infrastructure, wastewater, earthworks, concrete or general civil works would be highly relevant.
 
Location & Travel
 
The role is primarily based in Wellington, with regular travel to projects throughout the Manawatū and wider lower North Island.
 
You'll need to be comfortable getting out to site, spending time with project teams and travelling where required to support regional delivery.
 
Applicants must already have the legal right to work in New Zealand.
 
Interested?
 
If this sounds like the kind of step you've been looking for, apply with your CV or get in touch with Cathy Pearson at Stellar Recruitment for a confidential chat on 027 297 9350 or catherine.p@stellarrecruitment.co.nz.

job.title: Senior Construction Manager

Senior Construction Manager | Data Centres
Major Queensland Data Centre | FIFO / DIDO 
 
The Opportunity
An opportunity has become available for an experienced Senior Project/Construction Manager to take a lead client-side delivery role on a major, high-value data centre development in Queensland.
 
Working with a global project and programme management consultancy, you will be embedded within the client team and act as a senior representative on the ground, providing oversight across the developer, head contractor and wider delivery team.
 
This is not a traditional coordination-focused Project Manager position. You will be expected to understand what is happening on site, challenge programme and contractor performance, identify risks early and ensure the client has clear visibility across delivery.
 
The role is offered on a FIFO/DIDO basis, with flexibility around where you are based for the right candidate.
 
The Role
You will provide senior oversight throughout construction and play a key role in protecting programme, quality and critical milestones.
 
Key responsibilities will include:
  • Representing the client throughout construction delivery
  • Providing oversight across the developer and head contractor
  • Leading regular site reviews and developer meetings
  • Monitoring programme, milestones and critical path
  • Identifying delays, blockers and delivery risks before they impact the client
  • Challenging contractor performance and driving accountability
  • Identifying acceleration and programme recovery opportunities
  • Managing interfaces across GC, electrical and mechanical contractors
  • Monitoring MEP, services and commissioning activities
  • Ensuring works are inspection and milestone ready
  • Providing clear reporting around programme, risk, actions and recovery strategies
  • Maintaining strong relationships across client, developer, contractor and consultant teams
About You
This position requires someone with genuine construction delivery experience who is comfortable operating at a senior level within a complex, fast-moving project environment.
 
Ideally, you will bring:
  • Approximately 10-15+ years' project/construction delivery experience
  • Strong data centre or mission-critical project experience
  • Head Contractor / General Contractor background highly regarded
  • Strong understanding of construction methodology and site delivery
  • Experience across MEP, building services and commissioning
  • Strong programme and critical path management capability
  • Experience identifying and implementing programme recovery strategies
  • Ability to challenge senior contractors and developers constructively
  • Strong commercial and risk awareness
  • Confidence operating as a senior client representative
  • Relevant tertiary qualification in Construction Management, Engineering or similar
Candidates from a consultancy background will also be considered where they can demonstrate strong technical and mission-critical project delivery experience.
 
Why Consider This Opportunity?
This is an opportunity to move beyond traditional project coordination and represent the client on one of Queensland's significant emerging data centre developments. You'll be joining a globally recognised consultancy with an established data centre capability and exposure to major projects across Australia and internationally.
 
If you have delivered major data centre, mission-critical or technically complex projects and are looking for an opportunity with genuine client-side influence, I'd be keen to have a confidential conversation.

job.title: Site Safety Supervisor
job.description:
Site Safety Supervisor
Auckland - Fixed-Term Contract
  
Are you an experienced Health & Safety professional who enjoys being in the field, working alongside crews and ensuring critical controls are effective where they matter most?
  
We are seeking a hands-on Site Safety Supervisor to support a major project within an operating fuel terminal. This site-based role focuses on safety leadership, critical risk verification, permit compliance and helping construction teams deliver work safely and efficiently.
  
About the Role
Reporting to the Project Manager, you will be responsible for providing day-to-day safety assurance across multiple work fronts, ensuring activities are undertaken in accordance with approved safety plans, permits, procedures and critical risk controls.
  
Key activities will include:
  • Conduct site inspections, audits and verify critical safety controls across active work fronts.
  • Monitor permits, isolations, confined space activities and high-risk work compliance.
  • Oversee lifting operations, scaffolding, work at height and hot work activities.
  • Participate in pre-starts, work planning and provide practical safety guidance to site teams.
  • Investigate incidents and near misses while managing corrective actions and safety reporting.
  • Coordinate with contractors and stakeholders to ensure safe project delivery and emergency readiness.
  
About You
To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
  • NZ Level 4 Health & Safety qualification (or equivalent) with 5+ years' site-based HSE experience.
  • Strong background in high-risk industrial, construction, shutdown or maintenance environments.
  • Proven knowledge of permits, confined spaces, isolations, lifting, work at height and hot work.
  • Current First Aid certification and experience investigating incidents and corrective actions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across multiple contractors and workgroups.
  • Confident promoting safe work practices and influencing positive safety behaviours on site.
  
Highly Regarded
  • Diploma-level H&S qualifications, NEBOSH, IOSH or similar
  • ICAM or equivalent investigation training
  • Experience working around tank infrastructure, fuel terminals, refineries, energy facilities or other high-hazard sites
  • Knowledge of occupational hygiene and exposure monitoring programmes
  
What's on Offer?
  • Major industrial project with an immediate start available.
  • High-autonomy role with ownership of site safety outcomes.
  • Work alongside an experienced and collaborative project team.
  • Competitive remuneration package on offer.
  • Fixed-term contract running through to March 2027.
  
If you're a proactive safety professional who enjoys being on site, building relationships with crews and ensuring work is completed safely and efficiently, we'd love to hear from you.
Click ‘Apply’ now or contact Carlos for a chat.

job.title: Superintendent - Metallurgy
job.description:
• Lead metallurgy, process control and laboratory performance at a major zinc-lead operation
  • Senior leadership role with Glencore’s McArthur River Mine
  • Attractive FIFO roster, competitive remuneration and long-term career opportunities
Stellar Recruitment is partnering with Glencore to appoint a Superintendent – Metallurgy at McArthur River Mine in the Northern Territory.
Located approximately 970 kilometres south-east of Darwin, McArthur River Mine is one of Australia’s largest zinc-lead operations. The site incorporates an open-cut mine, processing facilities and a logistics network transporting concentrate to the Bing Bong Loading Facility for export to customers around the world.

This is an opportunity to take a senior leadership role within a technically complex processing operation and influence plant performance, recovery, product quality and continuous improvement.

The role:

Reporting to the Manager – Metallurgy and Port Operations, the Superintendent – Metallurgy will lead the site’s metallurgical, process-control and laboratory functions.

You will be accountable for ensuring metallurgical systems operate safely and effectively while delivering planned production volumes and product-quality outcomes. The position will provide technical leadership to the metallurgy and laboratory teams and work closely with processing, maintenance, technical and HSE stakeholders.

Key responsibilities will include:
  • Monitor and optimise plant metallurgical performance and process-control systems.
  • Identify performance constraints and coordinate practical remedial actions.
  • Lead the implementation of new process systems, equipment and plant upgrades.
  • Drive improvements in recovery, throughput, stability and concentrate quality.
  • Ensure the metallurgical laboratory operates safely, efficiently and in accordance with required standards.
  • Provide technical direction, coaching and development to metallurgical and laboratory personnel.
  • Lead, mentor and manage a multidisciplinary metallurgy and laboratory team.
  • Contribute to annual business plans, operating budgets, capital budgets and performance reporting.
  • Manage the availability, consumption and cost-effective use of major plant consumables.
  • Support plant trials, technical investigations and improvement projects.
  • Work collaboratively with production, maintenance and HSE teams to deliver safe and sustainable operational outcomes.
About You:

To succeed in this position, you will bring:
  • Tertiary qualifications in Metallurgical, Chemical or Process Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
  • Substantial practical experience within mineral-processing or metallurgical plant operations.
  • Strong knowledge of metallurgical processes, plant optimisation and process-control systems.
  • Experience in complex base-metal concentrators or flotation operations will be highly regarded.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing metallurgists, laboratory personnel or processing technical teams.
  • A sound understanding of metallurgical laboratory practices, sampling, analysis and quality control.
  • Experience delivering process-improvement initiatives, plant trials, equipment upgrades or operational projects.
  • Exposure to operating budgets, capital planning, cost control and technical performance reporting.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and decision-making capability.
  • The ability to translate technical findings into clear operational actions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across operational and technical functions.
Benefits:
  • Permanent senior leadership opportunity with Glencore.
  • Attractive FIFO 9 days on 5 days off roster from any capital city
  • Competitive remuneration package and applicable site benefits.
  • Support from an experienced site leadership and technical-services team.
  • Long-term professional development opportunities across Glencore’s Australian and international operations.
  • Work within a large-scale operation offering complex technical challenges and significant scope for improvement.

job.title: National Engagement Lead
job.description:
About TIACS

We are all about showing up where it matters — on worksites, in communities, and alongside the people and industries we’re in it with.

We are building one of the most innovative social purpose counselling services in the country and are looking for an experienced National Engagement Lead to join the team.

TIACS is Australia’s home of blue-collar counselling, providing free, confidential and accessible professional support to tradies, truckies, farmers, apprentices, blue-collar workers and the people who care about them.

No waitlists. No referrals. No cost.

This role is about making sure the people who need that support know TIACS exists, trust the service, and know how to access it.

TIACS - The Home of Blue Collar Counselling By Industry for Industry

The role

This is not a desk-based role.

Based in Brisbane, you’ll work nationally across worksites, industry events and community initiatives, building trusted relationships with workers, employers, industry groups and decision-makers.

You’ll lead TIACS’ engagement activity across priority industries and regions, while connecting on-the-ground insights with the broader partnerships strategy to identify opportunities and create longer-term impact.

The role includes regular interstate and regional travel, early starts, evening events and occasional weekend work.

If you enjoy being out with people and building relationships face-to-face, this could be a great fit.

What you’ll be doing
  • Building trusted relationships with workers, employers, supervisors and industry leaders
  • Representing TIACS across worksites, industry events and community activities
  • Delivering practical, relatable engagement that makes mental health support easier to understand and access
  • Building repeat engagement across priority industries and regions
  • Identifying partnership, alliance and fundraising opportunities from conversations in the field
  • Working closely with the Head of Partnerships & Impact to progress opportunities
  • Coordinating national engagement activity, bookings and travel
  • Capturing engagement activity, contacts and insights in HubSpot
  • Sharing on-the-ground themes, barriers and opportunities with the wider TIACS team
  • Supporting and guiding the Industry & Community Engagement Officer where required
Who we’re looking for

You do not need to be a counsellor. This is a non-clinical role.

We’re looking for someone grounded, credible and genuinely good with people.
You might come from a community engagement, partnerships, fundraising or field-based background.

More importantly, you’ll be someone who can walk onto a worksite and connect naturally with the crew, then sit down with senior leaders and hold your own.

You’ll need to be able to:
  • Build trust without relying on a polished sales pitch
  • Communicate naturally with different audiences
  • Handle sensitive conversations with good judgement and clear boundaries
  • Work independently and stay organised across a national travel schedule
  • Follow through on conversations and relationships h
  • Represent TIACS in a way that is authentic, approachable and down to earth
How to apply:

job.description:
Maintenance Officer (Workshop Parts)
 
Glencore Mount Isa Mines | Mount Isa, QLD | 7 Days On / 7 Days Off (Days Only)
 
Our client, Glencore Mount Isa Mines, is seeking an experienced Maintenance Officer to join their Mobile Maintenance team, supporting the ISF & Rebuild Workshop. This is an excellent opportunity to become part of one of Australia's leading mining operations, playing a vital role in ensuring maintenance activities are supported through the efficient coordination and management of parts and materials.

Working closely with planners, supervisors, leading hands and tradespeople, you'll help keep maintenance schedules on track by ensuring the right parts are available at the right time, while maintaining strong communication across the maintenance and supply teams.
 
About the Role:

You will be responsible for coordinating workshop parts and consumables, supporting maintenance planning activities, and ensuring workshop operations run efficiently.
 
What's on Offer:
  • Join Glencore Mount Isa Mines, one of Australia's premier mining operations.
  • Lifestyle roster of 7 days on / 7 days off (day shift only).
  • Work within a highly experienced Mobile Maintenance team supporting a large surface mining fleet.
  • Ongoing career development and training opportunities.
  • Competitive remuneration and the opportunity to build your career with a respected global mining company.
Your responsibilities:
  • Coordinating the dispatch and receipt of maintenance parts to support workshop rebuild and maintenance activities.
  • Working closely with maintenance planners, supervisors and warehouse personnel to ensure parts are available for scheduled work.

  • Coordinating the collection and delivery of parts and components across the operation.
  • Maintaining workshop consumable stock levels.

About You:
  • Previous experience in a maintenance support, workshop administration, stores or parts coordination role within mining or heavy industry.
  • Exposure to mobile mining equipment, heavy earthmoving equipment or heavy vehicle maintenance.
  • Willing to relocate to Mount Isa 
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to effectively manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • The ability to work both independently and within a collaborative maintenance team.

job.title: Supervisor - Surface Fleet Operations
job.description:
About the Opportunity

Stellar Recruitment is proud to partner with Glencore Mount Isa Mines to recruit a Supervisor - Isa Surface Fleet within the Isa Surface Operations Department.

Reporting to the Isa Surface Fleet Superintendent, you’ll oversee the people and mobile equipment responsible for bulk materials handling across site. The fleet includes dump trucks, Kress haulers, loaders, graders, watercarts and dozers, supporting the requirements of multiple operating departments.

This is an operations and production leadership role, suited to someone who has progressed from operating heavy mobile equipment into supervising a crew. You’ll balance production priorities, safe equipment movements and team performance, while working closely with maintenance to coordinate equipment availability.

The operating environment includes established infrastructure and confined work areas, so practical equipment knowledge, sound judgement and clear communication are essential.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead and manage a crew of up to 15 setting clear expectations around safety and production.
  • Plan and coordinate operators and equipment to meet shift priorities and material movement requirements.
  • Oversee bulk materials handling activities, including stockpile movements, wagon loading and slag handling.
  • Maintain safe operating standards around mobile equipment, infrastructure and other site users.
  • Coordinate equipment servicing and maintenance requirements with workshop supervisors.
  • Manage day-to-day personnel matters, crew performance and communication.
  • Liaise with other operating departments and contractors to support production and safe road and rail deliveries.
  • Complete shift paperwork, reporting and operational data capture.
About You
  • Strong hands-on operating experience with haul trucks and loaders.
  • Proven experience leading an operational crew, ideally having progressed from an operator background.
  • A practical understanding of mobile equipment operations, safe material movements and production requirements.
  • Confidence managing people, setting expectations and handling day-to-day personnel issues.
  • Computer literacy and the ability to maintain accurate records and reports.
  • Strong communication, time management and problem-solving skills.
  • A commitment to safe production and the ability to adapt to changing operational priorities.
What’s on Offer?
  • Residential Mount Isa position, allowing you to return home after each shift.
  • A 4-on, 4-off rotating day and night roster.
  • Responsibility for an operational crew and a diverse surface fleet.
  • A varied role combining production coordination, people leadership and collaboration across site.
Please note: Candidates must reside in Mount Isa or be willing to relocate.

If you’re an experienced operational supervisor with a strong mobile equipment background, we’d love to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion, contact Rob Gantly at Stellar Recruitment, or click Apply Now.

job.title: Shift Engineer (TBM)
job.description:
About the Company
  
Firmly positioned nationally and globally as a high-quality, top-tier contracting business, this company is flying in the current market. They have strong financial roots having built an impressive sustainable business by aligning with both public and private sector clients for major projects. They now have an IMMEDIATE need to appoint a civil SHIFT ENGINEER to their high-performance team in WA on a major project.
  
About the Role
  
As SHIFT ENGINEER you will be working 7/3, 7/4 roster (day/night shift 6am-6pm) on a major civil infrastructure project in Perth’s northern suburbs for the next 3 months minimum. You will be working at the TBM coalface “hands-on” during shift managing final delivery of the tunnelling works and demobilising the TBMs. You’ll need to attend pre-starts, present weekly toolbox meetings, and effective handovers after your shifts. This role requires at least 2 years prior site experience in a similar Site Engineer/Project Engineer role in civil contracting and preferably on TBM tunnelling scopes for Tier 1 or Tier 2 contractors (*not EPCM or Client Side). An extremely attractive hourly rate will be on offer based on your current level of relevant experience, and is negotiable.
  
Experience, Skills and Qualifications Requirements  
  • Bachelors degree in Civil/Structural Engineering (minimum)
  • 2+ years’ post graduate civil construction experience as Site/Project Engineer for prominent civil contractors in Australia
  • Previous experience managing TBM tunnelling scopes (preferred)
  • Past success and experience working on nightshift  
  • Willingness and ability to undertake 7/3, 7/4 roster (day/night shift 6am-6pm)
  • Can-do attitude and highly motivated
  • Currently residing in Perth’s northern suburbs with existing rights to work in Australia 
Benefits 
  • Classy Tier 1 Civil Contractor
  • 3 Month contract on a Major Civil Project
  • Superb Rate $65-80 (*Negotiable) 
Company Culture
  
The culture within this Tier 1 construction contractor is renowned as being one that supports career development and provides amazing opportunities for staff to work on the most high-profile, technically challenging and interesting projects there are. Led by a highly professional management team with an outstanding track record of success, you’ll be warmly welcomed into a construction business operating at the top of the civil industry where your contribution will be valued, acknowledged, and generously rewarded.

  • Strong generalist HR capability across the full employee lifecycle

  • Strong working knowledge of Australian employment legislation, Awards and Enterprise Agreements
  • Experience leading and developing HR teams
  • Confidence partnering with and influencing operational and executive leaders
  • Commercial, pragmatic and solutions-focused approach
  • Previous experience within the civil construction industry is essential

  • Must hold unrestricted working rights in Australia with no sponsorship requirements
What's on Offer:

  • Broad remit spanning HR, Talent Acquisition, Mobilisation and ER/IR

Due to continued growth, we're looking for an Intermediate Recruitment Consultant to join our Wellington team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with recruitment experience who is ready to build on their success in a supportive, fun, and high-energy environment.

As a Recruitment Consultant, you'll manage the full recruitment lifecycle while building strong partnerships with clients and candidates. Working alongside an experienced team, you'll have the opportunity to leverage our established market presence and client base. We provide the tools, support, and create the platform for success.

So, if you are hungry, show initiative and enjoy the chase of business development which creates a sale, then you are for us!

Our recruiters run a combined contractor and permanent desks, once established its continuous revenue with uncapped commission.

To be successful in this role, you'll bring:

  • Confidence in business development and networking.
  • Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • A genuine passion for helping people achieve their career goals.
What's on Offer?

  • Pool car and credit card for client visits.

  • A supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Wellington CBD location.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.

Why Stellar?

At Stellar Recruitment, people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a high-performance culture where success is recognised, development is encouraged, and teamwork is valued. You'll be joining a business with a strong reputation, experienced leaders, and exciting growth plans.

The practice includes mortgagee sale work as a core component, alongside a mix of property, commercial, trust, private client, and general advisory matters.

What You'll Gain
  • A genuinely broad practice rather than a narrow specialist role
  • Significant client contact and ownership of relationships
  • The ability to make decisions without layers of management
  • Stable, established work with a loyal client base

  • Strong grounding across property and commercial law
  • Confidence managing files independently
  • Excellent client relationship and communication skills
  • A practical, commercially minded approach

Culture
A collegial & down-to-earth team where senior lawyers are trusted to manage their practice, contribute ideas & build lasting client relationships. This established Auckland practice offers the breadth of work often associated with a larger platform while maintaining the accessibility & flexibility of a boutique environment. job.title: Commercial Litigation Lawyer
job.description:
One of New Zealand's most respected litigation teams is looking for a lawyer around the three-year mark to take on a caseload focused on insolvency and restructuring work in Auckland. The work is genuinely complex, the clients are high-calibre, and this team has a serious reputation in the market. You will need a litigation background to hit the ground running here, and some existing R&I exposure will put you ahead of the field.

The Role
You will be working across the full spectrum of restructuring and insolvency, from formal insolvencies and workouts through to distressed M&A, enforcement, and cross-border matters. There is also a steady stream of commercial disputes work in the mix, so you won't be limited to just insolvency matters. Clients include banks, credit funds, insolvency practitioners, corporate borrowers, and directors, both domestic and international.

Key Work 
  • Formal insolvency appointments and enforcement
  • Workouts, turnarounds, and distressed refinancings
  • Cross-border restructuring matters
  • Distressed M&A transactions
  • Director liability and third-party claims
  • Commercial disputes alongside the core R&I caseload
Day to Day Responsibilities   
  • Advising a sophisticated client base on complex insolvency and restructuring matters
  • Court engagement and preparation across a range of proceedings
  • Drafting pleadings, opinions, and transactional documents
  • Working across practice groups on multi-disciplinary matters
  • Running your own files with partner support when you need it
About You 
  • Around three years of New Zealand litigation experience, with some R&I exposure preferred
  • Comfortable in court and confident drafting pleadings and litigation documents
  • Strong academics; you will be asked for your transcript
  • Someone who writes well, thinks clearly, and does not need to be told twice
  • Comfortable working independently, but knows when to ask questions
What's on Offer   
  • Wellbeing allowance to spend however it is most useful to you
  • Flexible working and a home office allowance
  • Generous parental leave with structured support on the way in and out
  • Public transport benefit, late-night travel and meals covered when needed
  • Some flexibility around leave, including the option to purchase additional days
About the Firm 
A full-service national firm with a well-established litigation team and a restructuring and insolvency practice that carries genuine weight in the market. The team handles high-complexity domestic and cross-border work at volume, and the broader litigation group keeps things varied. This is a firm that takes development seriously and tends to attract lawyers who want to be stretched.

How to Apply
Please send your CV and academic transcripts to jenny.g@stellarrecruitment.co.nz or call 021 0230 3960 for a confidential discussion.

Please include your academic transcript with your CV, as this forms part of the initial review.

#SCR-jenny-gallagher

    • 3:00pm–11:30pm

Pay Rates Base rate + 15%-night loading:
  • Level 2: $29.93/hr + 15%-night loading = $34.42/hr

  • Reliable and punctual with a strong work ethic

Why Join Us? Working closely with the Loadout Manager, Supervisors, Scanner Team, and Forklift Operators, you'll play an important role in ensuring containers are safely moved, stored, and prepared for dispatch while maintaining strict food safety, cold-chain, and container security standards.

job.title: Business Support Administrator | Manufacturing
job.description:
Business Support Administrator | Manufacturing
Lower Hutt | Permanent | Full-Time | Monday to Friday
  
If you’re organised, practical and enjoy working in a busy environment where there’s always something happening, this could be a great fit.
  
Our client is an established Lower Hutt-based business operating in a hands-on engineering environment. Their administration team plays a key role in keeping the wider business running smoothly, and they’re looking for someone reliable who can come in, pick things up quickly and become a trusted part of the team.
  
This is a varied business support role with a strong accounts focus, alongside purchasing, timesheet administration and general office support. It would suit someone who enjoys being across different areas of a business and is comfortable working at pace.
  
What you’ll be doing
  • Processing supplier invoices and day-to-day accounts administration
  • Matching invoices, purchase orders and delivery dockets
  • Entering accruals and maintaining accurate financial records
  • Supporting purchasing across a range of business requirements
  • Liaising with suppliers and internal teams
  • Checking and collating weekly timesheets for payroll processing
  • Working within an ERP system and keeping information accurate
  • Resolving discrepancies and following up outstanding information
  • Providing general administration support across the wider business
What we’re looking for
  
You’ll ideally have previous experience in accounts administration, purchasing or wider business support, particularly within manufacturing, engineering, construction, logistics or another operational environment.
  
You’ll need to be confident working with invoices and financial information, comfortable handling a steady workload and able to maintain accuracy when things get busy.
  
Some purchasing experience would be valuable, along with the ability to understand what is being ordered, why it is needed and how it fits into the wider operation.
  
Experience using an ERP system is also important. We’re open on the specific platform, as long as you’re comfortable learning systems, following processes and working through something that may not always be particularly user-friendly.
  
Payroll experience is useful but doesn’t need to be extensive. The payroll side of the role is primarily focused on checking and collating timesheets before they are sent through to an external provider.
  
You’ll suit this role if you’re someone who:
  • Is reliable and takes pride in getting the job done
  • Enjoys being busy and naturally looks for what needs doing next
  • Has strong attention to detail
  • Is confident communicating with different personalities
  • Can manage competing priorities without getting flustered
  • Is practical, resilient and comfortable in a hands-on environment
  • Is happy to jump in and support the wider team when needed
What’s on offer
  • Permanent, full-time opportunity
  • Monday to Friday hours
  • Lower Hutt location
  • Varied role across accounts, purchasing, payroll support and administration
  • Established operational environment
  • Plenty of responsibility and variety day to day
  • Opportunity to become a valued part of a close-working team
If you’re an experienced administrator who enjoys a busy environment, likes having plenty to do and is comfortable working alongside operational teams, we’d love to hear from you.
  
Apply now with your CV or contact Cathy at Stellar Recruitment on 027 297 9350 or catherine.p@stellarrecruitment.co.nz for a confidential chat.

job.description:

What's on Offer

  • Strong technical and financial support
  • Large prospective land package with significant growth potential

  • Collaborative and experienced exploration team
  • Competitive salary and long-term career opportunities

They have around 75 current staff and are in an exciting growth phase. This role is ideal for a commercially astute Project Manager who thrives on full ownership of project outcomes, from cost control and program management through to client relationships and team leadership, and who is not seeking FIFO work, but who want a permanent full time Perth metro position.

The Opportunity

You’ll take responsibility for end-to-end delivery of civil construction projects, with a strong focus on FRP reinforced concrete structures, but with elements of civils and earthworks scopes. Working closely with senior leadership, you’ll play a key role in driving commercial performance, managing risk, and ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead delivery of civil construction projects valued up to $50m (MRWA/PTA) from award to completion
  • Manage all commercial aspects including budgets, cost reporting, forecasting, and variations
  • Provide technical leadership on FRP concrete coordination, methodology, and installation
  • Develop and maintain detailed project programs and procurement schedules

About You

  • Demonstrated experience delivering FRP concrete / FRP reinforcement projects
  • Strong commercial acumen with excellent cost control and reporting capability
  • Experience managing projects valued up to $40-50 million in Australia, NZ or UK
  • Confident leader with strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Solid understanding of Australian Standards, contracts, and construction methodologies
  • Currently Perth based, with existing Australian work rights.
What’s On Offer
  • Join a reputable local Perth contractor with a strong project portfolio
  • Autonomy to lead projects and influence commercial outcomes
  • Competitive salary package CIRCA $180-200K Base (*Negotiable)
  • Company Vehicle, Fuel Card, Phone & Laptop
  • Permanent long-term role with career progression opportunities
  • Supportive, hands-on leadership team with a practical approach
If you’re a driven civil Project Manager with specialist FRP concrete experience and a sharp commercial mindset, this is an opportunity to take ownership of challenging projects and make a real impact.

job.title: Environmental Officer - Greenfield Mining Project
job.description:
About the opportunity

Stellar Recruitment is partnering with an Australian mining company to recruit an Environmental Officer for a greenfield critical minerals project near Mudgee.

This is an opportunity to join during the development phase and help establish the environmental systems, plans and processes that will support the project as it progresses. You’ll work within an experienced environmental team, with exposure to senior management and scope to develop your expertise across a broad range of environmental disciplines.

The project is progressing through the approvals process, with groundworks targeted for 2028, subject to approvals. The proposed mining operation involves a single open pit and day-shift mining, with substantial company-owned landholdings in the surrounding area.

About the role

Reporting to the Environmental Superintendent, you’ll combine environmental management system development with monitoring, reporting and biodiversity-related activities. Rather than simply maintaining established systems, you’ll have the opportunity to help build them.

A key focus will be developing practical management plans, procedures, forms, registers and processes, alongside supporting biodiversity management across the company’s properties.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Contributing to the development and implementation of the environmental management system.
  • Supporting biodiversity assessments, monitoring programs and management of biodiversity properties.
  • Coordinating environmental inspections and monitoring across water, air quality, noise, heritage and biodiversity.
  • Interpreting environmental data, preparing reports and supporting regulatory compliance.
  • Working with internal teams, consultants and contractors to translate environmental obligations into practical actions.
About you

You’ll be an environmental professional who enjoys variety, works well independently and is comfortable building relationships across different teams. Experience in mining is welcome, but backgrounds in resources, construction, infrastructure or a regulatory environment will also be considered.

Ideally, you’ll bring a relevant qualification in Environmental Science, Environmental Management or a related discipline, together with experience developing environmental management systems and interpreting environmental requirements. Strong written communication, organisation and stakeholder engagement skills will be important.

Experience managing biodiversity properties, coordinating biodiversity assessments or monitoring programs, and working with the NSW Biodiversity Conservation Act 2016 will be particularly well regarded.

What’s on offer

An attractive remuneration package aligned with your experience, a supportive environmental team and the opportunity to broaden your expertise as the project develops.

You’ll work a 9-day fortnight, with accommodation available for the first six months to help you settle into the area. Set among rolling green hills and established rural communities, this opportunity would suit someone looking to build a career and a life in the Mudgee region.

Long-term residence in the area is required, although relocation does not need to happen immediately. There is flexibility to make the move over the first six to twelve months, allowing time to plan the transition.

How to apply

To express your interest, submit your resume through SEEK. For a confidential discussion about the role and relocation arrangements, contact the team at Stellar Recruitment.

job.description:

The operation:
  
George Fisher Mine (GFM) is a large-scale underground zinc-lead-silver operation based in Mt Isa, QLD. GFM has complex mining sequence, multiple operating fronts, and significant interactions among development, stoping, ventilation, backfill, infrastructure, services, and production readiness.
  
George Fisher has a long mine life and is a key strategic asset for Glencore globally.
  
The role:
  
The Senior Mining Engineer – Short Term Planning is responsible for leading and overseeing the preparation and delivery of short-term mine designs and plans to support the safe and efficient execution of development, production, services, and infrastructure activities
  
Your ability to translate medium- and long-term mine plans into practical short-term execution strategies aligned with operational capabilities and production targets will the crucial. We also need someone who can provide technical leadership and guidance to the mining engineering team and also optimise mine design / planning and drill and blast practices.
  
Experience required:
  • Tertiary qualifications in Mining Engineering or related subject
  • Minimum 6–8 years mining engineering experience, preferably within underground hard rock operations
  • Demonstrated experience in short-term mine planning, drill and blast design, and operational mine design.
  • Experience leading or mentoring engineering teams, graduates, or cadets.
  • Practical operational exposure with a strong understanding of underground mining methods and production processes.
  • Strong experience with mine design software such as Surpac, Vulcan, Datamine, or Deswik.

Benefits on offer:

• 2/2 Roster FIFO - Various points of hire
  • Epiroc Drills / CAT Dig Units
  • Attractive Remuneration + STIP
Great Site. Global career opportunities.

Stellar Recruitment is partnering with Glencore's McArthur River Mine to appoint experienced Mobile Maintenance Supervisors to its maintenance leadership team.

If you know mobile mining equipment and enjoy leading tradespeople in a high-performing environment, this offers an attractive combination: a 2/2 roster, quality operation, strong package and the opportunity to build your career within Glencore.

We are particularly interested in supervisors with strong experience across Epiroc D65's, DML/Pit Viper drills and CAT digging equipment
This isn't a role for someone who wants to supervise from behind a desk. We're looking for visible maintenance leaders who understand their equipment, know how to get the best from their crews and can drive safe, reliable fleet performance.

What's on offer
  • 2 weeks on / 2 weeks off roster
  • FIFO travel arrangements, or a $10,500 Darwin allowance
  • Attractive remuneration plus STIP
  • Work with major mobile mining equipment including CAT dig units and Epiroc drills
  • Established mine, camp and support infrastructure
  • Genuine opportunity to develop within a major mining operation
  • Long-term career possibilities across the broader Glencore business
McArthur River Mine provides the sort of scale and exposure that can accelerate a maintenance career. Come for the roster. Build your reputation. See where Glencore can take you.

How to apply:

Please submit your updated resume through SEEK or send your updated resume directly to my email below. I am also happy to take a call to discuss the role in confidence. 
 
Contact details:

job.title: Mobile Maintenance Planner | Glencore McArthur River Mine
job.description:
• 2/2 or 8/6 Roster FIFO
  • Attractive Remuneration + STIP
  • Various points of hire
Great maintenance starts with great planning.
Stellar Recruitment is proud to partner with Glencore's McArthur River Mine in the search for an experienced Mobile Maintenance Planner.

This is an opportunity for a strong maintenance professional (SAP experience desired yet not essential) to join a large-scale mining operation where quality planning directly impacts equipment availability, productivity and performance.

Working closely with maintenance supervisors, trades and operational stakeholders, you'll help ensure labour, parts, tooling and work scopes come together before the job hits the workshop.

What's on offer
  • Choice of 2/2 or 8/6 roster
  • FIFO travel arrangements, or a $10,500 Darwin allowance
  • Attractive remuneration package plus STIP
  • Exposure to a significant mobile mining fleet
  • Established operation with quality site and village infrastructure
  • Opportunity to improve planning, scheduling and maintenance execution
  • Career pathways within Glencore's broader Australian and global operations
We're looking for someone who understands that good planning isn't administration it is one of the biggest levers in maintenance performance. If you want to work at scale and build your career with a global resources business, McArthur River Mine is a great place to do it.

How to apply:

Please submit your updated resume through SEEK or send your updated resume directly to my email below. I am also happy to take a call to discuss the role in confidence.

job.title: Team Assistant
job.description:
• Up to $70,000 per annum
  • Professional environment, on the job training
  • Inner City Location
Our Client:
Our client is a respected New Zealand design and engineering consultancy known for delivering high quality structural, civil, and architectural solutions across commercial and industrial projects. They offer an integrated in house team that provides fully coordinated design services, giving clients a smooth and efficient experience from concept through to delivery. With strong long term industry partnerships and a reputation for practical, cost effective solutions, this is an organisation where collaboration, innovation, and professional growth are genuinely supported

About the role:
This pivotal role ensures the smooth day-to-day running of their office, supporting the project coordinators and overall operational excellence. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy being the go-to person who keeps everything running seamlessly, we’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Provide high-level administrative assistance to managers and staff.
  • Manage office supplies, equipment servicing, and vendor relationships.
  • Maintain accurate digital and physical records with strong document control.
  • Oversee the company fleet, ensuring vehicles are clean, safe, and compliant
  • Coordinate meetings, travel arrangements, and accommodation bookings.
  • Support internal events, training sessions, and company functions.
  • Process leave forms and timesheet data with accuracy.
  • Maintain CPD records and assist with catering and logistics.
Skills and Experience:
  • Proven experience in an administrative or receptionist role.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and general IT systems.
  • High attention to detail and a proactive problem-solving mindset. 
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Good sense of humour, team player and proactive approach.
How to apply
If you are energised by variety, enjoy helping others succeed, and can keep things running smoothly even when the pace picks up, we would welcome your application.

Apply online. Applications will be acknowledged within five working days. For a confidential conversation please call Fiona Sanderson 03 222 2304 or email fiona.s@stellarrecruitment.co.nz
  
Please note, only NZ Residents or Citizens will be considered for this permanent position.

About Stellar Recruitment
Since 2006, the Stellar Recruitment team has been dedicated to transforming the recruitment landscape. With years of experience and a focus on “Inspiring Growth, Changing Lives”, we partner with employers to fuel their growth while opening doors to life‑changing opportunities for job seekers.
